title: Apply a reviewed module evaluator plan without hand-copying configuration

fields.outcome: A maintainer can turn selected module suggestions into preserved project configuration through a deterministic preview-and-apply flow.
fields.scope: Extend module rather than add a top-level command. Present an interactive diff, optionally save its target state as a versioned handoff artifact bound to the base configuration digest, require explicit apply, preserve unrelated configuration, and never execute the proposed evaluator during wiring.
fields.acceptance: The exact reviewed proposal is what gets applied; conflicts and stale inputs stop without partial writes; resolving policy and running evaluation remain separate explicit actions.
fields.reproduction: Run module --name node-typescript in an enrolled repository and observe that it can only print or save generic evaluator templates.
fields.expected: After adapting and reviewing a proposal, the maintainer can apply that exact proposal to project configuration with preservation and conflict checks.
fields.observed: The maintainer must currently hand-copy evaluator and profile entries, with no framework validation or safe merge path.
fields.verification: Cover preview-only operation, exact apply, duplicate IDs, changed config after preview, malformed proposals, user-owned fields, missing scripts, no-test repositories, frozen snapshots, and interrupted writes.
fields.dependencies: Implemented on the survey contract and ADR-0013 monorepo/profile decisions.
fields.risks: Treating a generic template as repository truth could configure nonexistent or unsafe commands; apply must never imply that an evaluator passed or was approved.
fields.changes: Implemented legacy-compatible templates plus preview/apply, human-readable diff, versioned target-state handoff, base digest, unrelated-config preservation, conflict/stale-base rejection, no-test degradation, adoption profiles, and deterministic workspace identities.
fields.evidence: Function and CLI tests cover preview/apply, target preservation, stale plans, missing tests, advisory/required profile additions, and frozen snapshot staleness.

criteria.expectation: Module presents a deterministic interactive diff and can save the identical target state as a versioned handoff artifact without modifying project configuration.
A separate explicit action applies only the exact reviewed proposal and rejects a proposal whose recorded base configuration has changed.
Apply preserves unrelated evaluators, profiles, policy sources, lifecycle settings, hooks, and other consumer-owned configuration.
Duplicate identifiers, incompatible definitions, invalid schema, and write failures produce a conflict or error without a partial configuration change.
Preview and apply do not execute any discovered or proposed target-repository command; evaluation requires a later explicit command.
When repository evidence does not identify a usable test command, module reports the missing choice and does not silently configure a guessed evaluator.
Applying configuration does not rewrite a frozen resolved snapshot or create approval; resolve and evaluate remain explicit subsequent steps.
Workspace evaluator IDs and cwd values are deterministic, collision-safe, and traceable to declared workspace names or canonical repository-relative paths.
